purpose: Evaluate the existing fixed attack/defence plus Elo recipe independently in each league without retuning on these results
candidateInformationFence: UTC midnight at the start of the date containing simulatedForecastAt minus four hours; exclude the entire boundary date
unseenTeamPolicy: exclude and report; never silently use a neutral team rating
refitting: Rolling past-only fits, once per league and distinct cutoff date; earlier evaluation results can train later forecasts only after the information fence
preliminaryGate: Both aggregate probability metrics improve over production v1 in both periods and neither audit metric worsens in any league
historicalAdvantageGate: Preliminary gate plus upper bounds below zero for both audit paired calendar-day bootstrap intervals
limitations: These historical periods have already been inspected. This is retrospective development, not an untouched test or evidence of future accuracy.
The recipe was selected earlier using EPL data; transfer to the other leagues is an experiment, not a new parameter search.

Production v1 retains its exact 24-hour replay and four-hour result fence. The date-based candidate conservatively excludes the entire boundary date, potentially losing up to 24 additional hours of otherwise available results.
Only the two frozen seasons per league are available; promoted clubs can have little history. Coverage and all exclusions must be reported.
Historical final scores and kickoff times are observed now; contemporaneous result-publication and rescheduling logs are unavailable.
Player availability, confirmed lineups, weather, xG and betting odds are not used.

The original one-hundred-match packet, probabilities and source inputs remain immutable. Any later candidate series must have its own actual registration timestamp and exclude fixtures less than 24 hours away.
